title: Kingfall: Chess, but pieces battle it out. (GPT6 Astra & Opus 5.5)
author: Tommzy97
selftext: Not a ultra impressive 3D scene as most other posts on this subredit, but I am creating this mostly using GPT-6 Astra & Opus 5.5 and my core idea is to create a chess game where each taken piece is actually fought out in a couple seconds fight sequence with comic sfx & vfx. As base normal chess rules apply, but then there are misc magic items that spice things up. I am currently working in creating a 20 unique level campaign where difficulty (ELO) increases gradually with 5 different factions where each has special items and tricks up the sleeve. I guess we'll see where this goes.
